messages:
anna: quick follow-up from the postmortem: nightly batch + deploy-rollout noise is still paging on short cpu spikes. want a compact action list with owners and dates.

javier: yep, saw multiple duplicate pages per-host. happy to consolidate.

priya: i'll audit which alerts use instant vectors vs recording rules. instant ones probably causing the noise.

mike: plan suggestion: 1) switch paging eval to 5m aggregate, 2) dedupe by cluster+asg+service, 3) add calendar silence for 02:40-03:30 UTC. low-priority notifier for transient events.

anna: owners: javier -> dedupe keys + infra-alerts PR (due 2026-02-12), priya -> recording rules audit & PR (due 2026-02-11), mike -> routing + calendar silence (due 2026-02-10). i'll verify results after 48h.

javier: will include fallback so we don't hide cross-service incidents (include service label when present). PR template will have screenshots.

priya: audit started. early findings: 6 alerts use instant node cpu; will convert to node:cpu:5m_avg recording rule and update alerts.

mike: adding routing snippet to PR: initial -> #infra-alerts, escalate to #oncall only if for >10m or error_rate correlates. also create a low-priority pager channel.

ops-bot: linked incident: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-02-05-1684|INC-1684>. last noisy pages at 03:05 UTC during rollout.

anna: confirm in-thread when you start. target: reduce pager volume for this rule by >=50% after canary. I'll mark items in the postmortem tracker.

javier: starting now, will tag reviewers.

priya: converting rules now, PR in a few hours.

mike: routing PR up next. expected staging deploy tonight.

anna: great. thanks everyone. we'll re-evaluate after canary and close items if noise drops. :white_check_mark:
